decision: Architecture regen was a human card but is fully automatable (deterministic, no creds, cwd=repo_root). Operator hit 'NO SYSTEM MAP YET' on quantre-migration: root cause = (1) regen run in DontPanic repo not the scoped project, (2) DontPanic not a registered project, (3) serve watcher ignores architecture.json. Fix = make refresh automatic. Operator chose 'cache-only for display + hook commits': the build regenerates a missing/stale map into the dashboard CACHE only (F001, shipped) so the tracked repo working tree is never dirtied by a DP build; the committed copy stays fresh via an auto-installed pre-commit hook (F003). F002 adds architecture.json to the serve watch. Existing test test_build_emits_view_state_even_when_architecture_missing asserted the OLD absent-state behavior; updated to the self-heal contract (fresh map, not 'absent → run regen') — spec-clarification, not a regression.

F002 — serve watch fingerprint (_source_fingerprint) now includes each tracked project's docs/architecture/architecture.json (via projects_registry.load_registry). The watcher previously fired only on plan-file edits, so a regen (commit-hook or manual) left the Architecture tab stale until a manual rebuild. Absent maps are represented as (key,0,0) so a later appearance registers as a diff. Best-effort: registry errors never crash the watcher. NOTE — this watches the committed map, not the project SOURCE tree (live auto-regen on uncommitted source edits is a heavier follow-up; F001 self-heals stale on the next build regardless of trigger).

F003 — `dontpanic projects add` now installs the chained pre-commit architecture hook by default (architecture_hook.install(repo, auto_regen=True)), so commits keep the committed map fresh — the operator's 'runs regularly after commits' ask. Guards: --no-hooks opt-out; only installs when <path>/.git exists (never fabricates a .git in a non-repo); prior pre-commit hook preserved (chained to pre-commit.pre-dontpanic, not clobbered); any install failure is surfaced in output but never fails the registration. The installer already existed (plan 2026-05-19-004 F005) but was opt-in + installed in zero repos.
